observations.behavior: Adds a new module, byte_bounded_extraction_flag.py, that checks a PostHog feature flag to decide whether warehouse extraction should use byte-bounded batching. The module queries Team and calls posthoganalytics.feature_enabled, returning False on any error. P1.F1.H1

observations.behavior: Adds a new module, batching.py, that implements byte-bounded row fetching and batch flushing. It estimates row bytes, measures plan, and yields batches bounded by accumulated bytes rather than row count. P1.F2.H1
